notToBeConfusedWith.name: Lager
notToBeConfusedWith.note: The generic entry here is filed at lager strength; a stout or a wheat beer runs to a different sugar and colour and is not this record.

forms.label: Pale lager
forms.animalOriginNote: Many beers are fined with isinglass, made from fish swim bladders, for clarity; unfiltered and vegan-labelled beers are not, and the label is the only way to tell for a given bottle.
forms.sourceNote: Alcoholic beverage, beer, regular, all. Public domain. A pale lager, the style a Michelada is built on, sits close to this generic record's own 5% ABV; a darker or maltier beer would read sweeter than this figure shows, which is left as a stated limitation rather than corrected without a source.
